lane_scenario.inventory_scope: Synthetic reservation-capacity fixture for this comparison; not a recorded warehouse stock snapshot or permanent exclusivity claim
lane_scenario.scope: Controlled feasible-plan comparison. It does not establish that closest-node routing would split this basket; Reno can already supply the full basket. Fixed per-parcel scenario freight excludes billable-weight changes and surcharges.

cohort_scenario.assumption: Exactly three units are assigned to every three-plus order to make this cost model reproducible. This is not a reconstruction of an original per-order ledger.
cohort_scenario.scope: Conditional paired-basket cost model. Carrier totals and split counts are supplied scenario inputs, not outputs of a carrier quote or routing engine.

capstone_context.scope: The Capstone uses its separate $7.20 freight assumption. This file does not relabel a Brooklyn example as evidence for #35070, establish a carrier quote, or prove that Reno routing was erroneous.
